name: 星战英雄
english_description: The game's full title is "Sands of a Turbulent World: Star War Hero," an early domestic MudOS title in the "xkx" lineage. Despite the sci-fi-sounding name, it's actually a traditional wuxia MUD built around jianghu sects and internal/external martial cultivation — "Star War" was simply a catchy name chosen by the original author, with no connection to space warfare.
